design: MLP11 response replaced by linear term, quadratic term, their sum, or zero, around its same-prompt native output; keep original signed Attention5 perturbation and downstream computation live. All 192 prompts, both doses/signs.
metrics: Reference KL and group-NLL computed in float64 from float32 model logits; margin/group-NLL errors versus sum. Normalize errors by sum-versus-zero-response discrepancy to isolate this MLP contribution rather than whole-network perturbation. Central and per-sign effects separately.
scope: Bilinear expansion after normalization. Incoming normalized-input changes can themselves be nonlinear in injected dose. Linear-only refers to MLP response in that input change, not whole-network linearity.
